purpose: C1 actual synthetic counterexample: identical dictionary/span scores, preserved split versus lost or context-aliased source function
budget: <=60 seconds CPU4threads, arrays under10MB, 0 pretrained LM/SAE train/audit/external assets
selection_rationale: Common32request panel supports conditional function but lacks same-operation global matching and cannot identify unselected outcomes. Test nonvacuity first with known lost information rather than add another selected winner.
model: Fixed generated 5->9->7 tanh/softmax downstream consumer per seed, shared across families/methods. NOT a language model or trained SAE.
source_encoder: h=[u,v,w,c,n], all nonnegative, c binary; source codes=h and decoder=I5. u/v/w/n independently zero-inflated U(.25,1), active probability.25.
target_decoder: Six columns [e1,e1,e2,e3,e4,e5], identical in all three families. Codes [u(1-c),u*c,v,w,c,n] in preserved; first two zero in deletion; [u(1-c),n*c,v,w,c,n] in alias. Multiplicative notation is exactly implementable by ReLU(u-c) and ReLU(u+c-1) on this bounded domain. Alias uses ReLU(n+c-1).
geometry: Rectangular max-absolute-cosine assignment (MCC min-width definition) via exhaustive small assignment; all three scores1. This is deliberately NOT an atom-inconsistency claim. Span projection score1 even when q decoder columns are dead.
fit: Existing fit_hook_space_transport rank1, independent mean centering, uniform discovery weights. Existing best_single_atom conditional_variation=True over all six target codes. Frozen global assignment maps source q=e1 to first tied target e1, sign/norm coefficient1; NOT perquery best atom.
evaluation: Independent generated recipient/donor pairs, same binary context within pair; source operation .1*(u_d-u_r)*e1. Target readout difference applied to SAME source recipient h before SAME nonlinear consumer. Report coordinate squared error/source energy, KL to source/source-to-base KL, both contexts and combined. No inference over generated seed pairs as independent real SAE evidence.
limits: Handcrafted executable nonnegative encoders with known information loss; no optimization/feature-learning claim. Current hook-based FCC and ordinary source-aligned regression coincide here; no novel solver or advantage over equally informed regression. Zero/negative results retained. No universal GL nonnegative-invariance assertion.
